description: FrieslandCampina Engro Pakistan Limited is a dairy company that describes its purpose as nourishing Pakistan. It operates two production facilities, at Sukkur and Sahiwal, a dairy farm at Nara, and a milk-supply network of independent farmers and more than 1,300 milk collection centres, selling through a nationwide retail footprint.
sourceNote: Company website (frieslandcampina.com/pk: about-us), read 2026-10-17. The site publishes a press contact address only, with no registered office or telephone number.
